npcs.name: Nileno Dorvayn
npcs.greet: House Hlaalu does not ask where you were born, only what you can do and what it costs. Sit. Let us discuss the second part first.

npcs.name: Crassius Curio
npcs.greet: Oh, a new face! Do come in. I am Councilor Crassius Curio, patron of the arts, friend of the House, and an enthusiastic judge of character. Mostly of the character's calves.

npcs.name: Tirvel Sadrano
npcs.greet: Ebony, raw and honest, straight out of the hill. Well. Straight out of the hill, anyway.

npcs.name: Meril Vandas
npcs.greet: Give me stone, coin and a season without raiders, and I'll give you a manor the whole West Gash will envy.

relics.name: Hlaalu Rent Ledger
relics.desc: Rents owed to the Council Manor by Balmora's shopkeepers. Several pages are marked in red.

relics.name: Crate of Caldera Ebony
relics.desc: Raw ebony from the Caldera mine, weighed, sealed and stamped with the Hlaalu mark. All of it this time.

relics.name: The Tong's List
relics.desc: Names of Hlaalu loyalists in Balmora, several crossed out. The last name is Nileno Dorvayn's.

relics.name: Deed to Rethan Manor
relics.desc: A Hlaalu land grant for a manor on the Odai plateau, signed with a flourish by Councilor Curio.

hl_curio_grant: Nileno tells me you've saved half of Balmora from the Tong. How heroic. How useful. A House needs strongholds, and you need a roof.
There's a lovely bit of rock on the Odai plateau. Build something there. Something sturdy, and preferably with a nice bathhouse.
hl_grandmaster: In the Hlaalu Council chamber in Vivec, the councilors argue over coin, then over each other, then, finally, over you.
Rethan Manor stands. The Tong is beaten in Balmora. The ebony flows and the ledgers balance. I can think of no one better.
Nor I, and I can think of a great many people. Grandmaster of House Hlaalu, then. Try to look surprised.

quests.title: Errands for the Manor
quests.offer: I'd like to work for House Hlaalu.
quests.pitch: Everybody starts as a hireling. The Manor's storeroom is overrun with rats, and Nevos the factor still hasn't brought me this month's rents. Deal with both and I'll put your name in the books.
quests.desc: Councilor Nileno Dorvayn of the Hlaalu Council Manor in Balmora offered me work as a hireling: clear the storeroom of vermin and collect the month's rent ledger from Nevos, the House factor.

objectives.text: Clear the rats from the Council Manor's storeroom
Collect the rent ledger from Nevos the factor
objectives.topic: Nileno Dorvayn wants this month's rent ledger.
objectives.reply: Of course she does. Tell her the red marks are the shopkeepers who claim they've already paid the Tong. That's her problem now, not mine.

objectives.text: Bring the ledger to Nileno Dorvayn
objectives.topic: The rats are gone and here is the ledger. Nevos says the red names are paying the Tong.
objectives.reply: Then the Tong is collecting our rents in our own city. Welcome to House Hlaalu, hireling. You'll find we have a great deal of work.

quests.outro: I joined House Hlaalu as a hireling under Nileno Dorvayn. Already it is clear the Camonna Tong has its hands in the House's pockets.

consequence.summary: I joined House Hlaalu as a hireling under Nileno Dorvayn. Already it is clear the Camonna Tong has its hands in the House's pockets.

quests.title: The Caldera Ebony
quests.pitch: The ebony shipments from Caldera have been arriving light. A crate here, a crate there. The trader Tirvel Sadrano swears it's the miners. Go and find out whose pockets are heavy.
quests.desc: Ebony shipments from the Hlaalu mine at Caldera keep arriving short. Nileno sent me to find out whether the trader Tirvel Sadrano is skimming them.

objectives.text: Travel to the Caldera ebony mine
Question Tirvel Sadrano
objectives.topic: The House says your shipments are short.
objectives.reply: Short? Bandits, my friend. There's a gang in the old shaft taking crates at night. I'd deal with it myself, but I'm a merchant, not a fool.

objectives.text: Clear the thieves out of the old shaft
objectives.journal: The thieves weren't bandits. They were miners on Tirvel Sadrano's payroll, and their crates were already addressed to a buyer in Vivec.

objectives.text: Recover the stolen ebony crate
Confront Tirvel Sadrano

choices.label: Your thieves are dead. Pay back the House, or I report you.
choices.reply: All right! All right. The difference, with interest. You're a hard one for a hireling. Hlaalu will do well with you.

choices.label: I'm telling Nileno everything.
choices.reply: Then I'll be on the first silt strider out of Balmora. Tell her the ebony was always good, at least.

objectives.text: Bring the ebony to Nileno Dorvayn
objectives.topic: Sadrano was skimming his own shipments. Here is what he stole.
objectives.reply: A trader who robs himself to rob us. Clever, until it wasn't. You handled it like a Hlaalu: the ebony back, the problem solved, no fuss in the streets.

quests.outro: I recovered the stolen Caldera ebony and dealt with Tirvel Sadrano, who had been skimming the House's shipments.

consequence.summary: I recovered the stolen Caldera ebony and dealt with Tirvel Sadrano, who had been skimming the House's shipments.

quests.title: The Tong's Grip
quests.desc: Hlaalu loyalists in Balmora are being murdered, one by one. Nileno believes the Camonna Tong, Orvas Dren's men, are behind it, and that she is next.

objectives.text: Speak with Nileno Dorvayn
objectives.topic: You sent for me. You look worried.
objectives.reply: Two of our loyalists dead this week, both with their throats cut, both after refusing the Tong's protection. The Tong drinks at a warehouse by the river. Find out who gives the orders.

objectives.text: Break the Tong enforcers at the riverside warehouse
Kill the Tong captain, Vadryn Gols
objectives.journal: Vadryn Gols carried a list of Hlaalu loyalists. The ones crossed out were dead. The last name on it was Nileno Dorvayn's.

objectives.text: Take the list to Councilor Crassius Curio in Vivec
objectives.topic: The Tong has a list of Hlaalu loyalists. Nileno is on it.
objectives.reply: Dren's men, crossing out Hlaalu names like a grocery list. How very vulgar. Leave it with me; the Council will hear of it.

quests.outro: I broke the Camonna Tong's cell in Balmora and saved Nileno Dorvayn's life. Crassius Curio was so pleased he granted me land on the Odai plateau.

consequence.summary: I broke the Camonna Tong's cell in Balmora and saved Nileno Dorvayn's life. Crassius Curio was so pleased he granted me land on the Odai plateau.

quests.title: A Stronghold on the Odai
quests.desc: Crassius Curio has granted me land on the Odai plateau to build Rethan Manor, a Hlaalu stronghold. First the plateau needs clearing, and the builder needs paying.

objectives.text: Travel to the Odai plateau
Clear the cliff racers nesting on the building site
Show the deed to the builder, Meril Vandas
objectives.topic: This land is mine now. Can you build here?
objectives.reply: Can I? Look at the view. Sign here, and bring me the first payment, and we'll have walls before the next ash storm.

objectives.text: Pay Meril Vandas five gold ingots for materials
objectives.reply: Good, honest gold. My crew starts at dawn.

objectives.text: Wait while the foundations of Rethan Manor are laid
objectives.journal: By the second evening, the walls of Rethan Manor stood waist-high on the Odai plateau, and Meril's crew was arguing about the bathhouse.

quests.outro: The first walls of Rethan Manor rise on the Odai plateau. The House has a new stronghold, and so do I.

consequence.summary: The first walls of Rethan Manor rise on the Odai plateau. The House has a new stronghold, and so do I.

quests.title: Rivals at the Gate
quests.desc: Orvas Dren cannot let a Hlaalu stronghold stand on the Odai plateau, overlooking his routes. Meril Vandas sent word that armed men are gathering below the half-built walls of Rethan Manor.

objectives.text: Hurry back to Rethan Manor
Drive off the Tong's hired blades
Kill their leader, the mercenary Ulvo Telas
Check on Meril Vandas
objectives.topic: They're gone. Is the manor standing?
objectives.reply: Scorched, not broken. We'll finish the roof by the end of the week. Go to Vivec. Nileno says the Council is meeting, and your name keeps coming up.

quests.outro: I defended Rethan Manor from Orvas Dren's mercenaries. The stronghold stands, and the Hlaalu Council has taken notice.

consequence.summary: I defended Rethan Manor from Orvas Dren's mercenaries. The stronghold stands, and the Hlaalu Council has taken notice.

quests.title: Grandmaster of Hlaalu
quests.desc: The Hlaalu Council meets in Vivec, and Nileno Dorvayn and Crassius Curio mean to put my name forward as Grandmaster. I will need to win over the waverers first.

objectives.text: Travel to the Hlaalu Council in Vivec
Speak with Crassius Curio before the vote
objectives.topic: Nileno says you mean to nominate me.
objectives.reply: I do, and I've counted the votes. We're two short. How do you propose to persuade the stubborn ones?

objectives.text: Decide how to win the Council's vote

choices.label: With gold. Everyone in this House has a price.
choices.reply: Spoken like a true Hlaalu. I'll see the envelopes delivered discreetly.

choices.label: With Caldera ebony contracts. Make it worth their while.
choices.reply: Oh, clever. Bribes that look like business. They'll vote for you and thank you for the privilege.

choices.label: With the truth. Rethan Manor stands and the Tong is beaten.
choices.reply: How refreshing. It might even work, if I stand behind you looking stern.

objectives.text: Attend the Council's vote
objectives.reply: It is. Stand straight and let them look at you.

quests.outro: The Hlaalu Council named me Grandmaster of House Hlaalu. Rethan Manor is my seat, and the House's ledgers are now my problem.

consequence.summary: The Hlaalu Council named me Grandmaster of House Hlaalu. Rethan Manor is my seat, and the House's ledgers are now my problem.
